name: Local Null AI Site Modernization
intent: Modernize a copied local_null_ai web tool into a production-quality local/agent workspace without touching the original site.
scope: Work only inside the selected local_null_ai_* folder.
Keep metadata, sitemap, robots, and redirects complete for shipped pages.
Preserve dark UI consistency unless the tool clearly uses a different visual system.
Do not expose secrets in frontend code.

steps.title: Read the app flow
steps.prompt: Inspect routing, data flow, forms, metadata, and build scripts. Identify the smallest safe modernization path.

steps.title: Add agent surface
steps.prompt: Document how an agent can start, test, build, and operate the tool locally.

steps.title: Complete production baseline
steps.prompt: Fix obvious placeholders, broken links, metadata gaps, and dead actions while keeping changes scoped.

steps.title: Verify
steps.prompt: Run configured lint/typecheck/tests/build where available and record blocked validation honestly.
